data.name: Maqoom
data.gender_notes: Maqoom is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Maqoom refers to Allah's Throne, signifying stability, power, and divine presence. The name Maqoom carries the meaning “The Stationed One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maqoom usually hope their child will grow to embody the stationed one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of Allah's divine presence and power in our lives.
data.etymology: Maqoom belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Stationed One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maqoom total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
